_comment: docs/specs/benchmark.md §3: the benchmark's configuration — the model policy's rhythm and limits, the seed suites, the score, the defaults sent to the model, the HTTP settings. `prompt_version` / `parser_version` are bumped by any change to the prompt text or format / the parsing rules (benchmark.md §5–§7); both go into the cache key and every entry. The key is never here: it is read from the environment variable `http.key_env`. Presentation data, not loaded by the core (SCHEMA §10); read by BenchConfig (S6.12).
